_comment: endpoints/v1 skeleton - what your tool DISCOVERED, not what it found wrong. One entry per operation; unknown keys are ignored. Machine-readable copy: dynast-bench schema --json

endpoints._comment: http - kind is optional, it is inferred from the fields present
a concrete id is fine; the scorer templates it to {id}
a full URL works too - the host and port are stripped
a required ?action= selector IS part of the identity - include it or this credits nothing
a sidecar on its own port
graphql - the op behind POST /graphql, which is its own separate entry
a security-relevant field is its own operation
ws - the handshake alone; it does not exercise the events
...each event does, and a channel pins it to one room
llm - a tool the agent can actually invoke, not the route that starts a run
net - a service, for the port-discovery apps
